description_zh: 🪷 位於暹羅凱賓斯基飯店大廳，連奪六年米其林一星的 Sra Bua 於 2026 年 7 月以全新面貌重啟。泰國東北出身的主廚 Num Weerawat Triyasenawat（前 Samuay & Sons 主理人）接手後，以「泰國生物多樣性」為主軸，推出 11 道菜嘗味菜單：Signature Biodiversity Journey（海陸時令食材）與 Plants & Roots Forward Journey（植物導向），食材來自全國農漁戶，並結合自設 Mah Noi Food Lab 的發酵工藝。
description_en: 🪷 Located on the lobby floor of the Siam Kempinski Hotel, Sra Bua reopened in July 2026 under a bold new identity. Chef Num Weerawat Triyasenawat — the Udon Thani-born talent behind the Michelin-recommended Samuay & Sons — now helms this six-time Michelin-starred icon, anchoring its 11-course tasting menus in Thailand's biodiversity. Choose between the Signature Biodiversity Journey (land-and-sea seasonal ingredients) or the Plants & Roots Forward Journey (plant-led, no meat), with produce sourced from farmers and foragers nationwide and ferments from his own Mah Noi Food Lab.
address: 991/9, Siam Kempinski Hotel, Rama I Rd, Khwaeng Pathum Wan, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330

evidence.title: ร้านอาหารใหม่ น่าแวะไปเช็กอิน ประจำเดือนสิงหาคม 2026
evidence.quote: 米其林餐廳於暹羅凱賓斯基飯店重新開幕，強調泰國生物多樣性主題。

name_en: หงส์ ทรงวาด / HONG Songwat
name_zh: หงส์ ทรงวาด / HONG Songwat
description_zh: 🦢 坐落於曼谷唐人街旁的 Song Wat Road，HONG Songwat 以套餐形式端出正在消失的泰式古早家常料理，融合各地區傳承食譜，每道菜皆有故事。共桌用餐、精緻擺盤，搭配結合烹飪學校的理念，致力讓失傳古菜重回餐桌。
description_en: 🦢 Tucked along the revived Song Wat Road near Chinatown, HONG Songwat champions vanishing Thai home-cooking traditions through a set menu of regional, time-honored recipes that are increasingly rare on Bangkok menus. Beautifully plated dishes come with stories behind each course — a dining concept tied to a Thai cooking school mission to bring ancient recipes back to life. Shared-table seating adds to the communal feel.
address: 995 Song Wat Rd, Khwaeng Samphanthawong, Khet Samphanthawong, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10100

evidence.title: ร้านอาหารใหม่ น่าแวะไปเช็กอิน ประจำเดือนสิงหาคม 2026
evidence.quote: 結合泰式烹飪學校與餐廳，致力復興失傳的古代泰菜食譜。

description_zh: 🌊 藏在 Soi Charoen Krung 72/1、The Salil Hotel Riverside 園區內，Elpaso 以現代伊比利半島塔帕斯結合泰國在地食材為核心，俯瞰昭披耶河。分享式小盤依西班牙手法重新詮釋，搭配手工調酒，入夜後有 DJ 駐場，從河畔晚餐到深夜派對一氣呵成。
description_en: 🌊 Tucked inside The Salil Hotel Riverside complex on Soi Charoen Krung 72/1, Elpaso pairs modernist Iberian-inspired tapas with premium Thai local ingredients, all overlooking the Chao Phraya River. Sharing plates reimagined through a Spanish lens, handcrafted cocktails, and a DJ spinning into the early hours make this the spot for riverside dinner and late-night parties in one.
address: 2052/7-9 Soi Charoen Krung 72/1, Khwaeng Wat Phraya Krai, Khet Bang Kho Laem, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10120

evidence.title: ร้านอาหารใหม่ น่าแวะไปเช็กอิน ประจำเดือนสิงหาคม 2026

description_zh: 🥐 藏身曼谷老城區 Fueang Nakhon Road 轉角，一棟奶油色四層舊街屋，對面正是 Wat Ratchabophit 的白色佛塔。自詡「把艾菲爾鐵塔換成泰式佛塔的巴黎咖啡館」，內部以白、粉色調裝潢，二、三樓露台可直面寺廟佛塔，是全店最搶鏡打卡位。菜單主打咖啡、自製 Gelato 及法式糕點，招牌為 Thai Tea Float 與 Affogato，另有馬卡龍、閃電泡芙與泡芙。MRT Sam Yot 三號出口步行約 500 公尺。
description_en: 🥐 On the corner of Fueang Nakhon Road in Bangkok's historic Phra Nakhon district, this four-story cream shophouse sits directly opposite Wat Ratchabophit — swapping the Eiffel Tower for a white Thai pagoda. The pastel pink-and-white interior spans multiple floors, with the 2nd and 3rd floor balconies framing the temple's iconic chedi — the café's most viral photo spot. The menu features coffee, house-made gelato, and French patisserie including macarons, éclairs, and choux cream, with the Thai Tea Float and Affogato as signature orders. About a 500m walk from MRT Sam Yot Exit 3.
address: 65 Thanon Fueang Nakhon, Khwaeng Wat Ratchabophit, Khet Phra Nakhon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10200

evidence.title: 22 คาเฟ่ (Cafe) น่านั่ง โลเคชั่นคูลๆ มุมถ่ายภาพไม่ซ้ำ ใครๆ ก็ตามไปปักหมุดได้ ...
evidence.quote: 新開幕咖啡廳，三層樓設計，可眺望วัดราชบพิธ，裝潢精美，甜點飲品完備。

description_zh: 🍹 佔據前 Tropic City 舊址，由 Cholos 與 Birdies Bangkok 同一班底 Ratish Sachathamakul 和 Jennifer Evans 打造。一樓牆上有手繪壁畫，抽雪茄女士那幅最是搶眼；飲單涵蓋蘭姆酒、龍舌蘭精選與招牌 Bangkok Sling，樓上 Cholos 的 burrito 和 nachos 可直接點餐送桌，懶散又過癮。
description_en: 🍹 Taking over the former Tropic City space on Soi Charoen Krung 28, this no-frills bar is from the same crew behind Cholos and Birdies Bangkok — Ratish Sachathamakul and Jennifer Evans. Inside, hand-painted murals set the mood, with the lady-with-a-cigar piece stealing the show. The drinks list spans rum, agave spirits, and classics, with the Bangkok Sling as the crowd favourite. Hungry? Order burritos and nachos directly from Cholos upstairs — they'll bring it right to your table.
address: 672, 65 Soi Charoen Krung 28, Khwaeng Bang Rak, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500

name_en: Sontaya Society (สนธยา สมาคม)
name_zh: Sontaya Society (สนธยา สมาคม)
description_zh: 🥥 藏在曼谷 Bang Rak 區馬哈帕魯塔拉姆路上的老泰式街屋，raw & rustic 風格裝潢保留斑駁牆面與木質傢俱，由店主親自招呼。招牌是碧武里新鮮椰子水咖啡與泰式食材調酒，也供應 Lao Beer 老撾啤酒。曾舉辦舒恩布詩人日等文化活動，咖啡因與酒精全天候共存，是低調又有個性的在地新據點。
description_en: 🥥 Tucked into a weathered Thai shophouse on Mahaphruttharam Road in Bang Rak, Sontaya Society keeps things raw and rustic — rough walls, wood furnishings, and an owner who looks after guests personally. Signature sips include fresh Phetchaburi coconut coffee and Thai-ingredient cocktails, alongside Lao Beer on the menu. The bar doubles as a cultural hang, having hosted Sunthorn Phu poetry nights, and welcomes caffeine and alcohol fans alike from daytime onward.
address: 104 Thanon Mahaphruttharam, Khwaeng Maha Phruttharam, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500

evidence.title: บาร์เปิดใหม่ น่าไปลอง 2026 ประจำเดือนกรกฎาคม - Lifestyle Asia
evidence.quote: 新開幕咖啡酒吧，支持白天飲酒，提供咖啡因和酒精飲品。

description_zh: 💿 藏身 Naradhiwas Rajanagarindra 路 150 號大藍門後，由 Yayyyyy Record Bar 同一批主理人 DJ Rom 與 DJ Ice 打造。以日本 Jazz Kissa 為靈感，深色木質吧台正對整面黑膠牆，負責選曲的「Bar Viber」同時兼顧飲品與全場氣氛。招牌調酒有 Melon Melon Sawa、Smoky Aomori，還附免費小零食。
description_en: 💿 Tucked behind a large blue door at 150 Naradhiwas Rajanagarindra Rd, OBi is the Silom sibling of the beloved Yayyyyy Record Bar, founded by the same DJ duo—DJ Rom and DJ Ice of City Boy. The name nods to the obi strip on prized Japanese vinyl pressings, and the vibe delivers: dark wooden counters face floor-to-ceiling record shelves, while a 'Bar Viber' curates both the soundtrack and the cocktails. Try the Melon Melon Sawa or Smoky Aomori, and don't skip the complimentary snacks.
address: Thanon Naradhiwat Rajanagarindra, Khwaeng Suriya Wong, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500

evidence.title: บาร์เปิดใหม่ น่าไปลอง 2026 ประจำเดือนกรกฎาคม - Lifestyle Asia

description_zh: 🌰 藏身 Soi Yen Akat 3 的法式秘境。由摯友主廚 Dominique Salles 與餐飲人 Mathieu Campion 聯手打造，兩人合計逾 15 年餐飲經歷，餐廳名稱呼應童年榛樹與法式焦香奶油。Salles 以古典法式技法掌廚，Campion 帶來在 Sühring 近十年外場功力。菜單涵蓋五道式套餐、單點與三道式午餐，介於街坊小酒館與精緻餐廳之間。
description_en: 🌰 Tucked into Soi Yen Akat 3, Noisette is the creation of childhood friends chef Dominique Salles and restaurateur Mathieu Campion, who bring over 15 years of hospitality experience between them. The name nods to the hazelnut trees they grew up beneath and French cooking's beloved beurre noisette. Salles anchors the kitchen in classical French technique, while Campion brings nearly a decade of front-of-house mastery from Sühring. The menu spans a five-course tasting menu, à la carte, and a three-course lunch — somewhere between a neighbourhood bistro and fine dining.
address: No. 1, Thanon Yen Akat, Khwaeng Chong Nonsi, Khet Yan Nawa, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10120

evidence.title: Table talk in Bangkok (October 1-15)
evidence.quote: 法式古典烹飪，由巴黎四季飯店主廚與餐飲業者聯手開設

description_zh: 🔥 位在 Decho Rd、Bang Rak 巷弄裡的 Michelin Bib Gourmand 泰式居酒屋，「Aunglo」即泰式傳統炭爐，幾乎每道菜都以炭火完成。吧台座位正對開放廚房，主廚近在咫尺現場烤製。招牌必點：椰子煎餅佐炭烤蝦、泰式柚子沙拉、自家版烤豬肉串（Moo-Ping），座位搶手，建議預約。
description_en: 🔥 A Michelin Bib Gourmand Thai izakaya tucked along Decho Rd in Bang Rak — the name "Aunglo" literally means traditional Thai charcoal stove, and nearly every dish is fired over one. Grab a counter seat for a front-row view of the chefs grilling right in front of you. Must-orders: the coconut pancake with grilled shrimp, pomelo salad, and their signature moo-ping skewers. Seats are limited, so book ahead.
address: 174/4-6 Decho Rd, Khwaeng Suriya Wong, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500

evidence.title: Table talk in Bangkok (October 1-15)
evidence.quote: Aunglo姐妹餐廳，專門油炸泰菜，強調酥脆外皮

description_zh: 🥪 東京銀座炸三明治名牌 Age.3（アゲサン），由 MAGURO GROUP 引進，在 Dusit Central Park 一樓開設泰國首店。麵包現炸後夾入輕盈鮮奶油，外酥內軟卻完全不油膩；甜口有 Whipped Cream、Banana Brulée，鹹口有 Egg Salad、Potato Salad，還有曼谷限定的打拋口味炸三明治，僅此一處。
description_en: 🥪 Age.3 (Agesan), the viral fried sandwich brand from Tokyo's Ginza district, opens its first Thailand flagship at Dusit Central Park G Floor, brought in by MAGURO GROUP. Each sandwich is freshly fried to order — crispy outside, light and fluffy inside, never greasy. The 30+ item menu covers sweet picks like Whipped Cream and Banana Brulée, savory options like Egg Salad and Potato Salad, plus a Bangkok Exclusive Pad Kra Pao sando you won't find at any other branch in the world.
address: G Floor 946 Thanon Rama IV, Si Lom, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500

name_en: MITR STREET มิตรสตรีท
name_zh: MITR STREET มิตรสตรีท
description_zh: 🔥 由米其林餐飲集團 Supanniga Group 打造，在老城 Tha Tien 巷弄裡豎起六層樓泰中街頭料理地標。以火焰鑊氣為靈魂，招牌有朋友炒牛肉、烏拉勞伊蝦刺身、紅炭烤雞與蟹肉炒蛋。頂樓「ThaiKi Rooftop Bar」融合 Tiki 酒吧與泰中風情，俯瞰臥佛寺全景，是曼谷目前最話題的新景點。
description_en: 🔥 A six-storey Thai-Chinese street food landmark tucked into Tha Tien's historic lanes, from Supanniga Group—the Michelin-recognized force behind Ruay Mitr and Supanniga Eating Room. Everything is built around fire and wok energy: signature pengyou fried beef, urak lawoi prawn sashimi, red charcoal-grilled chicken, and creamy crab omelet. Climb to the top floor for ThaiKi Rooftop Bar, where Tiki-meets-Thai cocktails pair with a jaw-dropping unobstructed view of Wat Pho.
address: 119 Soi Tha Suphan, Khwaeng Phra Borom Maha Ratchawang, Khet Phra Nakhon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10200

evidence.title: Table talk in Bangkok (October 1-15)
evidence.quote: 六層樓泰式中華街邊美食餐廳，強調火焰與鑊氣烹飪

description_zh: 🌴 位於 Sukhumvit 40 的 T-One 大廈 46 至 50 樓，Tichuca 是曼谷最具話題性的高空叢林酒吧。2020 年底開幕後迅速爆紅，核心亮點是酒吧正中央那棵隨夜色變換色彩的巨型 LED「水母樹」，設計靈感宛如《阿凡達》場景。木質家具、熱帶綠植多層露台環繞，搭配 360° 全曼谷天際線；招牌調酒 Yuzu Colada 整顆鳳梨盛裝上桌，La Fresa 以自家蘭姆酒、草莓柑橘和黑薄荷調製，DJ 現場播放 Organic Tech-House 電音。入場須年滿 20 歲並出示護照正本。
description_en: 🌴 Perched on the 46th–50th floors of the T-One Building on Sukhumvit 40, Tichuca has been one of Bangkok's most talked-about rooftop bars since opening in late 2020. The centerpiece is a massive color-shifting LED 'Avatar Tree' that pulses to live DJs spinning Organic Tech-House. Multi-level terraces wrapped in tropical greenery and wood furniture frame a 360° Bangkok skyline. Signature cocktails are the real draw: the Yuzu Colada arrives inside a whole pineapple, while La Fresa blends house rum with strawberry cordial, black mint, and absinthe. Bring your original passport — strict 20+ age check at the lobby.
address: Building 46 fl, T-one, Soi Sukhumvit 40, Khwaeng Phra Khanong, Khet Khlong Toei, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110

evidence.title: Table talk in Bangkok (October 1-15)

description_zh: 🍶 位於蘇潤翁 Montien Mall，由香港餐飲雙人組 Christopher Mark、Vidur Yadav 攜手仙台出身、歷練東京／雪梨／倫敦／香港的名廚 Shun Sato（前 Censu 主廚）共同打造。開放式廚房飄出炭火香，必點 Fire Scallop 藍焰上桌、軟殼蟹塞入魷魚起司慕斯佐漬蛋黃、Hamachi Ponzu，酒單更有罕見未過濾生酒。喧鬧熱烈，正是居酒屋本色。
description_en: 🍶 Tucked inside Montien Mall on Surawong, KIZARU is the Bangkok debut from Hong Kong hospitality duo Christopher Mark and Vidur Yadav alongside chef Shun Sato — born into the izakaya trade in Sendai, seasoned across Tokyo, Sydney, London, and Hong Kong (ex-Censu). The open kitchen hums with charcoal energy; standouts include the Fire Scallop served in blue flames tableside, soft shell crab stuffed with squid-cheese mousse and cured egg yolk, Hamachi with Ponzu, and a sake list featuring rare unpasteurized bottles. Loud, lively, and utterly izakaya.
address: 50Montien Mall, Room G3, 1st Floor, แขวงสี่พระยา เขตบางรัก กรุงเทพมหานคร 10500

description_zh: ☕ 米蘭老牌糕點名店，創立於 1817 年、隸屬 LVMH 集團，東南亞首家完整分店落腳 One Bangkok。必點 Tiramisu 與 Chocolate Cornetti，Covachino 咖啡搭配現烤可頌是標準組合；樓上正宗義式餐廳與酒吧亦在籌備中。
description_en: ☕ Milan's legendary patisserie founded in 1817 and part of the LVMH group — One Bangkok is home to its first full-fledged branch in Southeast Asia. Don't miss the tiramisu and chocolate cornetti; pair a Covachino with a fresh-baked croissant for the classic Cova combo. A full Italian restaurant and bar upstairs is also in the works.
address: One Bangkok, The Storeys Building, Units 2G33, 2G34, 2120, 2121, 199 ถ. วิทยุ แขวงลุมพินี เขตปทุมวัน กรุงเทพมหานคร 10330

evidence.quote: 米蘭經典咖啡館，提供義式咖啡、新鮮烘焙糕點和高級巧克力。

description_zh: 🍦 Guss Damn Good 旗下冷凍優格品牌，以 0% added sugar 的 Greek Yogurt soft serve 為核心。招牌 Adam's Pistachio 以義大利進口開心果為配料，香氣濃郁；經典款 Adam n Eve 淋上橄欖油與蜂蜜；Theo's Pistachio Choc Crunch 則將開心果與自製巧克力醬結合，酸甜綿密口感叫好又叫座。藏在 The Storeys B1，近 7-Eleven 與 MUJI。
description_en: 🍦 A sub-brand of Guss Damn Good, Adam n Eve serves Greek yogurt soft serve with 0% added sugar — guilt-free and surprisingly creamy. The star is Adam's Pistachio, loaded with imported Italian pistachios, while the classic Adam n Eve drizzled with olive oil and honey is pure indulgence. Theo's Pistachio Choc Crunch layers pistachio with house-made chocolate sauce for a crunchy finish. Find it on B1 of The Storeys, near 7-Eleven and MUJI.
address: The Storeys ชั้น B1, One Bangkok Entrance 3, Thanon Witthayu, Khwaeng Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330

evidence.title: New One Bangkok Mall Stores Opening in 2026: Latest Updates

description_zh: 🏪 泰國街頭文化霸主 CARNIVAL 於 2026 年在 One Bangkok 開設迄今最大旗艦店，橫跨兩層逾 1,300 平方公尺。由創辦人 Pint Anupong 自 2010 年從一間小球鞋店起家，店內劃分運動鞋專區、CARNIVAL RUNNING 跑步裝備區、SECTOR-01 藝術展覽廊、透明玻璃 POPUP HAUS 聯名展間，以及 CARNIVAL COFFEE 咖啡吧，緊鄰倫披尼公園，跑步後順道補貨喝咖啡一條龍。
description_en: 🏪 CARNIVAL ONE BANGKOK is the Thai streetwear icon's biggest flagship yet, spanning over 1,300 sqm across two floors inside One Bangkok. Founded in 2010 by Pint Anupong from a single sneaker shop, the space is divided into dedicated zones: a performance running corner (CARNIVAL RUNNING), a rotating art gallery (SECTOR-01), a transparent glass POPUP HAUS for collabs and limited drops, and CARNIVAL COFFEE downstairs. Right next to Lumpini Park — finish your run, grab a coffee, cop some kicks.
address: Room 2G29, G Floor & Room 2119, 1st Floor The Storeys 199 Thanon Witthayu, Khwaeng Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330

evidence.title: New One Bangkok Mall Stores Opening in 2026: Latest Updates
evidence.quote: 街頭風格旗艦店，提供限量運動鞋、服飾、聯名線和藝術玩具。

description_zh: 🌿 藏身 Pridi Banomyong 1（Edison Alley）小巷，由曼谷永續調酒先鋒 Gov 與 Tot 主理。菜單「World Wild Waste」分三章：重詮經典、野生食材、廚餘再生，Fossil Fuel（蟹殼魚骨）與 Morning After Espresso（咖啡糠）是代表作。舊冰箱、廢棄燈具構成空間骨架，並提供試飲份量。榮獲 2025 Bangkok Bar Show 最佳新酒吧。
description_en: 🌿 Tucked down Edison Alley off Pridi Banomyong 1, this sustainability-driven cocktail bar is led by founders Gov (Kitibordee Chortubtim) and Tot (Dharath Hoonchamlong). Their 'World Wild Waste' menu unfolds in three acts: classic riffs, foraged wild flavours, and upcycled kitchen by-products — think Fossil Fuel (crab shells, fish bones) and Morning After Espresso (coffee chaff). The raw interior is built from old fridges, reclaimed lamps, and repurposed sofas. Tasting-size pours let you work through the menu without commitment. Winner of Best New Bar at the 2025 Bangkok Bar Show Awards.

description_en: 🦀 Tucked into a lane off Soi Naradhiwas 17 in Sathorn, this is the Bangkok outpost of celebrated Surat Thani restaurant Synth สินธุ์. Le Cordon Bleu-trained Chef Boss reimagines Southern Thai tradition through European technique — highlights include Kanchanadit oysters with three house sauces, a French-style crispy duck breast in red curry, and a crab betel-leaf curry. The menu rotates seasonally.

description_en: 🥩 Tucked on the 2nd floor of Fairmont Bangkok Sukhumvit on Soi Sukhumvit 20, Harper's is a French-American brasserie built around an open kitchen, a seafood display counter, and theatrical tableside service. The flank steak, steak tartare, and tuna tataki are standout dishes, while the burgers and French-style bakery hold their own. The space splits into distinct zones — equally suited for a business lunch or a relaxed family dinner.

The matcha menu spans five House Blend options plus a rotating Seasonal Matcha (previously featuring Marukyu Koyamaen). Pair your bowl with Mitarashi Dango or Warabi Mochi for the full experience. Google-rated 4.8 — a slow-life sanctuary for serious matcha lovers.

description_en: ☕ Tucked down Soi Charoen Nakhon 18 in Khlong San, this Thonburi branch of the award-winning Old School Specialty Coffee & Roastery — Wongnai's #1 café in Nonthaburi and a World ESYEN runner-up — brings serious coffee credentials to the neighbourhood. The two-floor rustic space pairs old wooden desks and lush potted plants with a calming central waterfall feature. Must-orders: the signature Esyyenn and the cinnamon-star anise iced coffee; add a bagel with ham and cheese or truffle Shio Pan on the side. The quiet second floor has Wi-Fi and is a go-to for digital nomads. Parking behind the shop; short walk from BTS Krung Thon Buri Exit 4.

description_zh: 🐶 上海爆紅烘焙品牌首度登台，進駐 Siam Paragon G 樓 Gourmet Garden。英倫復古石牆裝潢搭配「Bagel the Dog」招牌吉祥物，逾 250 款品項中以巧克力可頌、蛋撻、司康、現烤貝果及限定狗狗造型麵包最受歡迎。目前泰國是全球唯一海外據點，開幕即引發大排長龍。
description_en: 🐶 Shanghai's viral bakery sensation makes its one and only overseas debut at Gourmet Garden, G Floor, Siam Paragon. The British vintage interior — stone walls, hanging pots, rustic décor — is anchored by the iconic 'Bagel the Dog' mascot throughout. With over 250 items to choose from, top picks include the chocolate croissant, egg tart, scone, freshly baked bagel, and limited-edition dog-shaped bread. As Thailand's sole global outpost, expect queues from the moment you arrive.

description_en: 🏠 Tucked into Soi Ramkhamhaeng 21, Openface is housed in a Korean-style timber building that feels straight out of Seoul's Seongsu district. The all-day brunch and bakery menu brings a Korean-Asian twist to Western classics: Eggs Benedict with a lime-brightened hollandaise, crispy nori with house-cured salmon, chicken and waffles, plus standout pastries including a yuzu croissant and almond croissant. Packed since its first week and a well-earned Google 4.7 rating.

description_en: 🐾 Tucked into the residential lanes of Samsen Nai, this community café is run by two passionate owners — with resident dog Sally ready to greet you. The star dish is the Miso-Buttered Blueberry Compote & Bacon Sourdough Sanga, a rich sweet-savory combo that keeps regulars coming back. Coffee and matcha are carefully sourced, and the Seasonal Soda (น้ำมะปี๊ด) pairs perfectly with the food. Cozy, pet-friendly, and well off the tourist radar.

description_en: 🏙️ Tucked on the 11th floor of SSP Tower 2 in Khlong Toei, Citycup BKK frames a sweeping view of PAT Stadium — home of Port FC — and Bangkok's skyline through floor-to-ceiling windows. Raw concrete walls, exposed ceilings, vintage speakers, and a giant Game Boy beside the photo booth give the loft-style space an industrial-meets-playful edge. Go-to orders include the Matcha Latte, Cappuccino, and Bacon Twist pastry. MRT Queen Sirikit Exit 1 drops you right at the door.

description_en: 🔥 Tucked inside Canopy Bangkok Sukhumvit on Soi 12, Cante is Hilton's flagship Spanish fire grill and taberna in Southeast Asia. Drawing from Barcelona, Valencia, and Andalusia, the kitchen fires up wood-fired sharing plates like roasted suckling pig and a 1kg steak made for the table. AvroKO's bold, print-filled interior brings serious energy without overwhelming — pair that with a well-curated Spanish wine list and warm service, and this is easily one of Bangkok's most exciting Spanish newcomers.
